charts.question: Adjusted associations remain estimates, not intervention effects
charts.supported_finding: The multivariable Cox model reports hazard-ratio direction and interval width alongside apparent discrimination.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Observed associations remain vulnerable to omitted variables, treatment selection, and cohort transport.

charts.question: The absolute risk contrast is paired with resampling uncertainty
charts.supported_finding: Low ejection fraction is associated with a higher observed event rate, and the patient bootstrap shows how much that contrast moves.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The threshold was not prospectively registered and must not be interpreted as a treatment rule.

charts.question: Survival estimates retain censoring and the changing risk set
charts.supported_finding: The Kaplan–Meier view shows the observed follow-up experience without treating every patient window as complete.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Descriptive survival contrast; it does not identify a treatment effect.

charts.question: Candidate follow-up protocols expose capture–workload trade-offs
charts.supported_finding: Protocol comparisons make the operational trade-off visible instead of presenting risk separation as a complete decision.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Prospective validation and clinical ownership are required before any protocol use.
